The pandemic triggered some of the highest rates of opioid abuse that we’ve seen in years. 

Thankfully, we have resources like @bestselfwny, which is reaching people through its new 24-7 Virtual Treatment Center.

If you need help, one call can make a difference. 

716-463-6222 https://t.co/CsNx6Uhdm4

We know that when our healthcare workers are truly supported, our patients receive better care.

Proud to join members of @SEIU1199 to rally behind the Reinvest in NY Healthcare Act, which would require health insurers to keep healthcare dollars in NY - or pay a price. https://t.co/BDOZsjxgBY

We shared the good news at a Mental Health and Wellness Day that @CMChrisScanlon and I hosted in South Buffalo - a community that has lost at least five officers to suicide in the last 2 years. 

The free event featured 35 outstanding WNY agencies offering mental health support. https://t.co/B84sULGHq2

A cure.

We don’t hear that word often, but the @US_FDA announced a CURE for Sickle Cell Disease. Now, it’s imperative that we get that therapy to patients.

Today I joined @RoswellPark & patient advocates to call for the expedited Medicaid coverage of this life saving new drug. https://t.co/OeGm2BpLeP

ICYMI: February is American Heart Month, and this month our Single Moms Club will be centered around health and wellness!

Join @ms_everhart and I this Thursday, Feb. 15th at 5:30pm at East High School for a night of inspiration and education. https://t.co/ZDPW1WlA53

Bleeding disorders affect more than 1 in 100 NYers. As recently as the 1960s, there was no treatment for people who received a diagnosis. Fast forward to today, and there is far more hope & education.

Honored to recognize this month as Bleeding Disorders Awareness Month in NYS. https://t.co/xQxj9w8igU

The cuts to SNAP proposed in this year's Farm Bill move us in the wrong direction. SNAP keeps students and seniors fed and it supports our farmers. The absolute last thing we should be doing right now is cutting SNAP. Thanks to @RepJahanaHayes for leading the fight for nutrition. https://t.co/TQTiR1ZrnU

I'm pleased to announce new funding for @UBuffalo to study bacterial infection treatments. This investment will save lives and drive significant advancements in medical research, which will ultimately enhance our healthcare systems and save lives. https://t.co/fGNxppzwdh

Today, I announced $130,000 for @peopleincnews to replace outdated physical, occupational, and speech therapy equipment. As an occupational therapist, I know that this innovative equipment will improve outcomes & quality of life for thousands of patients. https://t.co/Z0hXWtKFaD https://t.co/X5PV0F9wYE

House Republicans' funding bill fails our veterans. In order to properly staff and maintain the VA hospital in Buffalo, and other hospitals across the country, full funding must be included. My full statement below: https://t.co/Sz92w5bd72

The @VetAffairsOIG report released today outlines egregious neglect and failure of the Buffalo VA leadership that harmed patients—those that sacrificed to safeguard our nation.  I am calling for further investigation to ensure this failure in care never happens again. https://t.co/Dvq3aMVsWN

The IV fluid shortage due to Hurricanes Helene and Milton jeopardized the care that patients rely on in our region and across the US. Today, I joined hospital and union leaders to call for the strengthening and diversification of our medical supply chains—WNY lives depend on it. https://t.co/oboonYSIKr

HAPPENING NOW: Join the @livewellerie Older Adults Health and Wellness Fair until 1 p.m. Find the resources and support you need for good health, including healthcare screenings, Medicare and Medicaid information, neighborhood support, and more! https://t.co/M0IrS5H3yJ

It's our duty to support survivors of human trafficking on the road to recovery. I’m proud to announce $525K in federal funding for @ECMCBuffalo’s BRAVE Trauma Recovery Center to expand its services—preventing future exploitation and helping patients take their lives back. https://t.co/VfpLVqbjhX

Look who stopped by! 

@billnye has helped generations of students get excited about science. Now, he’s joining physicians and patients advocating for those living with ataxia, which runs in his family. Together, guided by science (which rules), we can make progress! https://t.co/z5uquj7QFg

I’m happy to announce new @SocialSecurity resources for people living with sickle cell disease. Use these resources—designed for patients, their families, and their physicians—to better understand and secure the benefits you need to thrive. https://t.co/Uq18XSk2Pd
Important Deadline: The last day to enroll in ACA-compliant health insurance for 2025 coverage is January 31, 2025 for New Yorkers. To enroll or to learn more, please visit: https://t.co/pCX35IAeUc

On #WorldCancerDay, we remember those affected by cancer and renew our fight to beat this terrible disease. Thanks to institutions like @RoswellPark, we are advancing prevention and treatment. Together, we can take action—up to 50% of cancer cases and deaths are preventable.

Dental care is healthcare. I had a great discussion today with the American Dental Association about the impact the administration's policies will have on dentists and their patients. Together, we will work toward finding solutions that prioritize the well-being of our community. https://t.co/0ziQmn6xW9

As a licensed healthcare provider, I know that firing HHS workers strains our hospitals and puts lives at risk — delaying treatments, denying cures, and stealing hope from patients. These cuts are more than numbers on a balance sheet — these are lives that hang in the balance. https://t.co/xl9CGBxTi8

These amendments are about protecting people, making sure families don’t lose access to care, hospitals don’t collapse, and those who can least afford it aren’t left behind. Healthcare isn’t a luxury reserved for the rich, it’s a right. No matter what time of day Republicans try to force these cuts through, I’ll keep fighting. 🧵

Trump's "Big Ugly Bill" would rip $13.5 BILLION from New York’s healthcare system.

In Western NY, premiums could spike nearly 40%—that’s $267 more a month for working families.

As an occupational therapist, I've seen what happens when families can't afford care: minor conditions become chronic, emergency room wait times increase, and lives are put at risk.

We need everyone in this fight — stand up, speak out, and push back. Our healthcare is on the line.

House Republicans just advanced Trump’s rescission plan – gutting public broadcasting, slashing global health programs, and ripping support from working families to fund more tax breaks for the wealthy. I voted NO.

I’m fighting to make life more affordable for working families and for the future we deserve.

As the only occupational therapist in Congress, I know how life-changing OT can be, especially for those facing mental health or substance use challenges. 

My new bill expands access to these vital services under Medicare, helping make OTs a stronger part of our mental health response for those in need. We need to use every tool we have to fight this crisis.

I joined 152 of my House colleagues in filing an amicus brief to challenge the Trump Administration’s illegal and harmful cuts to life-saving NIH research.

These cuts threaten critical medical breakthroughs and undermine lifesaving public health research.

I’ll always stand up for Western New Yorkers and every American who depends on the life-saving work being done in our universities, hospitals, and research labs.

https://t.co/2QBL7XSTuu
